title: About
text:
Chemical engineering taught me that every system tells a story, as long as you measure it carefully. Somewhere between process calculations and renewable energy research, I realized the part I enjoyed most wasn’t the equations. It was the data, and that moment when a confusing pattern suddenly makes sense.
That curiosity became my career. Today, I help organizations turn scattered numbers into clear answers. It might be a dashboard a manager checks every morning, or a model that spots a trend before it becomes a problem. Either way, my goal is the same: make data easy to understand and easy to act on.

title: About
text:
What I believe
Clarity beats complexity. The best insight is the one people actually use. Teaching STEM has shown me that a clear explanation is worth more than a clever chart.
Good decisions start with good data. I’d rather spend an extra hour checking the numbers than have anyone act on the wrong ones.
Data should make a difference. I’m drawn to work in business intelligence, engineering, energy and climate, where better data leads to better outcomes for businesses, communities and the planet.

title: About
text:
Where I’m headed
I’m deepening my skills in AI, machine learning and cybersecurity, because the future of analytics is smarter, faster and more secure. Wherever data goes next, I want to help people use it well.

title: About
text:
Beyond the data
When I’m not working with data, I’m spending time with my family. They’re my biggest source of joy and my reminder of why the work matters. Good decisions, after all, are about people.

Have a question worth answering with data? Let’s talk.

title: Gregory Onokwai
text:
I’m a data analyst with an engineering background. I turn complex data into clear insights that help people make better decisions. I work with Python, SQL and business intelligence tools to clean, analyze and visualize data, and to build dashboards and models that answer real business questions.
My special interests sit where data meets the physical world: engineering, energy and climate. I enjoy using analytics and machine learning to understand performance, risk and change over time, and to communicate the findings in a way any audience can act on.
